_doc: Canonical places per council (hand-curated from the council research files). zones: the scheme's own zone names; regulated = Planning Regulation 2017 sch 2 zone it corresponds to (null = older QPP-era name). dwelling_house_permitted: true if the scheme's table of assessment makes a dwelling house accepted or code assessable in that zone (QHC 'permitted use'); null = not established by the research. raw_scopes maps each zone string used in research/councils/<slug>.json to scope rows; [] = whole local government; UNMAPPED = cannot be placed (left LG-wide, flagged). rule_key_scopes add place scopes for rules by key regex (Redland precincts are only identified in rule keys).
